content: The function Dem_DcmReadDataOfPID1C shall return the ap- propriate value OBD requirements to which vehicle or engine is certified. according to the respective standards [12], e.g. OBD, OBDII, JOBD etc. The value PID1Cvalue to return is in configuration parameter DemOBDCompliancy defined.
